name: CinePile
description: CinePile is a large-scale long video question answering dataset and benchmark designed to test authentic long-form video understanding, including temporal comprehension, human-object interactions, and event reasoning.
reputation: A well-known recent benchmark for long-form video QA that has been used to evaluate modern multimodal models on authentic long-video understanding.
notes: Dataset created using LLMs with human-in-the-loop; fine-tuning improves model performance but models still underperform humans.
